meta.note: Derived system: Ponytail's terminal palette and voice, re-pointed at collecting payments for a group trip to Puerto Vallarta.

tokens.name: fondo
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every ventana. Dark value is Ponytail's banner ground, exact.

tokens.name: superficie
tokens.usage: Inside a Ventana, cards and table bodies. Dark value is Ponytail's terminal window, exact.

tokens.name: superficie-alta
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, inputs, the TarjetaViajero header strip.

tokens.name: linea
tokens.usage: 1px borders of ventanas, table rules, the empty track of BarraAbono. Decorative only: it is not a control border.

tokens.name: linea-fuerte
tokens.usage: Input and quiet-button borders; meets 3:1 on superficie in both themes.

tokens.name: tinta
tokens.usage: Primary text and amounts, on fondo, superficie and superficie-alta. Dark value is the banner headline color, exact.

tokens.name: tinta-suave
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, folios, hints, on superficie and superficie-alta. Dark value is the banner subline, exact.

tokens.name: sol
tokens.usage: The one brand hue (Ponytail's orange, sunset over the bahía). Primary button fill, eyebrow labels, focus ring. As text on superficie in both themes.

tokens.name: sobre-sol
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a sol fill. Never white on the dark-theme sol.

tokens.name: sol-tenue
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind sol text: selected row, active filter chip.

tokens.name: bahia
tokens.usage: Secondary hue for trip facts that are not money: destination, dates, hotel, links. As text on superficie in both themes.

tokens.name: bahia-tenue
tokens.usage: Ground behind bahia text, e.g. the itinerary strip.

tokens.name: pagado
tokens.usage: Status: fully paid, and the filled part of BarraAbono. Always with the word 'Pagado' or an amount. Dark value is the banner's green light, exact.

tokens.name: pagado-tenue
tokens.usage: Ground of the Pagado status chip.

tokens.name: pendiente
tokens.usage: Status: an abono is due and not yet late. Always with the word. Dark value is the banner's amber light, exact.

tokens.name: pendiente-tenue
tokens.usage: Ground of the Pendiente status chip.

tokens.name: vencido
tokens.usage: Status: past the fecha límite. Always with the word 'Vencido' and the days late. Dark value is the banner's red light, exact.

tokens.name: vencido-tenue
tokens.usage: Ground of the Vencido status chip.

tokens.name: neutro
tokens.usage: Status 'Sin abonos' and baseline series in charts. Ponytail's chart gray.

tokens.name: neutro-tenue
tokens.usage: Ground of the neutral status chip.

tokens.name: sello
tokens.usage: Flat-square stamp chips (folio, 'MXN') — Ponytail's shields.io badge black. Text on it is always tinta-sello.

tokens.name: tinta-sello
tokens.usage: Text on sello.

styles.name: titular
styles.usage: One per screen: the headline over a ventana, usually the saldo pendiente.

styles.name: monto-grande
styles.usage: Totals and saldo in Monto size 'grande'. Tabular figures.

styles.name: monto
styles.usage: Amounts in rows and cards. Tabular figures, right-aligned in columns.

styles.name: ceja
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow over a titular, in sol, led by a ● dot. At most one per ventana.

styles.name: boton
styles.usage: Button labels, uppercase, verb first, trailing arrow on the primary.

styles.name: ruta
styles.usage: The path in a Ventana title bar, in tinta-suave.

styles.name: cuerpo
styles.sample: El segundo abono vence el 15 de octubre.

styles.name: nombre
styles.usage: A viajero's name in cards and rows.

styles.name: nota
styles.usage: Metadata under a name or amount, in tinta-suave.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a row; chip horizontal padding; the title-bar dot gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked metadata lines; between chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and table-cell padding; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Ventana inner padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Ventana padding on desktop; space above a titular.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, stamps, bars — Ponytail's chart-bar corner. Flat-square is the default.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs — the banner's waitlist button.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Ventana and TarjetaViajero — the banner's window.

tokens.name: anillo-foco
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in superficie, then a solid 2px sol ring. No other shadows in the system.
